steps.label: the same action again changes nothing
dropping the full schema moves it
the last copy of a repeated slug wins
a proposal arrives with the catalog
the same proposal refreshes rather than duplicating
a different proposal is a second row
no proposals leaves the stored ones alone
a different server is a different catalog

schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE local_cli_observation (
            cli_id text primary key,
            identity_hash text not null,
            kind text not null check (kind in ('executable', 'script')),
            name text not null,
            interpreter_name text,
            example_label text not null,
            observed_count integer not null check (observed_count >= 1),
            last_seen_at text not null,
            source_path text,
            help_status text,
            surface text not null default 'cli' check (surface in ('cli', 'mcp', 'package-scripts')),
            server_identity_hash text,
            server_command text,
            server_args_hash text,
            source_label text,
            remote_origin text,
            declared_sources_json text
        , first_blocked_cause text, last_trigger_summary text, last_why_now text, last_harness text, last_workspace_label text, last_context_at text)

CREATE TABLE local_mcp_workflow_proposal (
            cli_id text not null, identity_hash text not null, proposal_id text not null,
            proposal_json text not null, seen_at text not null,
            primary key (cli_id, identity_hash, proposal_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE local_mcp_provider_authority (
            cli_id text not null, identity_hash text not null, digest text not null,
            primary key (cli_id, identity_hash)
        )

CREATE TABLE local_mcp_provider_action (
            cli_id text not null,
            identity_hash text not null,
            provider text not null check (provider = 'composio'),
            tool_slug text not null,
            toolkit text not null,
            description text not null,
            input_schema_json text not null,
            authority_hash text not null,
            full_schema integer not null check (full_schema in (0, 1)),
            source_tool text not null,
            revision integer not null check (revision >= 1),
            updated_at text not null,
            primary key (cli_id, identity_hash, provider, tool_slug)
        )
